title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Five features read every source file of the project. Four release what they read when you switch the feature off or close the window. The dependency badge kept it.

highlights.title: Sweep Released On Exit
highlights.description: Around 5 MB of import lines, measured on a real project, stayed held by the dependency badge after the window closed or the badge was switched off. It now lets go, like its four neighbours.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A project sweep that finishes after the provider is gone, or after the badge was switched off, no longer hands its result back.
Switching the badge off with a sweep already finished releases it at once, instead of waiting for a sweep that a badge which is off never runs.
